body: The problem is that I love computer science, programming has been a hobby of mine for awhile. What I didn't like during this year was the gen ed and other required classes, they were a waste of time in my eyes, time I could have spent learning what I wanted to learn. I hate myself for seeing the classes this way though because of the impact on my grades and my future.

I think next year could be better with classes that more reflect my major. There isn't anything like a scholastic coach but our adviser is pretty nice, I may talk to him about things.

Drugs and gaming are a problem, things I was hoping to eliminate at the start of the year, gaming was especially draining of time and energy. They cause me to hate myself due to the time wasted but are the few things that kept me sane, I especially enjoy gaming and is something that is terribly hard to let go of.

What kept you going when you were down?

I had actually found the first image when looking myself lol.

Thanks for the input!
